20 Acre Hobby Farm With Water Rights. Price $899,000. 24291 SW Rogers Rd, Sheridan, OR 97378, Yamhill County.
20 acres fully fenced and cross-fenced. Mill Creek runs through the property. Water rights included. 1 water well.
Zoning: EF-80. 3 bed 3 bath home. 5-stall barn with tack room, greenhouse. Gravel/rock road frontage.
